name: source-2.18
decision: Source 2.18: the first boot after a Source update is logged to the cache partition (source-firstboot.sh, synced every 5 s) to catch the logo/black-screen hang seen after the 2.16 and 2.17 updates; the cache partition is mounted at post-fs. Based on source-2.17: Source 2.17: CFI enabled as on the factory image. Based on source-2.16: Source 2.16: Source Update finds the update server on the local network (no typing); source_updaterd detects the init-mounted cache partition. Based on source-2.15: Source 2.15: first release delivered by the in-headset Source Update (test of the update path: no functional change). Based on source-2.14: Source 2.14: in-headset Source Update (com.picovr.updatesystem replaces the factory SystemUpdate2, embedded in PICO Settings like the original; signed Source OTA packages from a configurable server or /sdcard/dload; source_updaterd stages them and reboots to the updater). Based on source-2.13: Source 2.13: picofacialdatadaemon sends the first MARCO at once (the client was dropped every 30 s); image on the 2.12 block layout. Based on source-2.12: Source 2.12: ActivityDisplay.onDisplayChanged ext hook last (factory order); TEMP display reorder caller logging; image built on the 2.11 block layout (base_fs) with release-independent UUID/salt. Based on source-2.11: Source 2.11: picofacialdatadaemon single socket reader (no spurious client drops while the headset sleeps) and 25 Hz send cap. Based on source-2.10: Source 2.10: business eye tracking mode for pxreyetrackingservice only (libpxreyetracking_tob preloaded through an override of its init service; PXR::EyeUtil::isDebugBusiness), nettools /proc rule for picofacialdatadaemon. Based on source-2.09: Source 2.09: picofacialdatadaemon (fork of thoricelli/PicoFacialDataDaemon, external/picofacialdatadaemon) as an init service with its own SELinux domain instead of the Magisk module. Based on source-2.08: Source 2.08: init logs ctl.* messages like the factory (DEBUG, silent on unknown names) - the per-second 'Could not find uimRemoteClient0' ERROR line went to the ttyMSM0 UART console on CPU7 and stalled the XR compositor ATW pass (TEARSCREEN_COST_ABNORMAL stripe once a second). Based on source-2.07: Source 2.07: Process.setProcessFreezeGroup JNI takes (pid, uid) as on the factory (the swapped arguments froze system_server on the first VRShell keep-alive freeze -> endless loading after setup); trial diagnostics (triallogcat/trialsnap) dropped, only the trial USB/TCP ADB enablement kept. Based on source-2.06: Source 2.06: on-device fixes after 2.05 (PhoneWindowManager.checkAddPermission allows PICO type 2998 floating windows: iFlytek symbols panel; gtop symlink not carried until the factory toybox gtop applet is ported) and the full native comparison fixes (init/fs_mgr stabd notifications, sigchain Unity handler, app_process signal 58, LightsService, libcutils jank tracing, libmeminfo GFX_cached/MemAvailable, tinyalsa/libmtp/OMX logs, VR audio service via factory libvraudio). Based on source-2.05: Source 2.05: device boot fixes (liblog Smartisan buffers sysevent/sysfatal/untrustedapp, libbpf_android loadProgWithUnlink, init panel -> ro.pvr.hmd.type INNOLUX5K) and PICO port pass 6 (ART/libcore Smartisan extensions, bionic GWP-ASan, audio updateSecondaryOutputs + libeffects spatializer, libmmparserextractor, WFD/HDCP + ANetworkSession/ParsedMessage, small PICO/Smartisan residue, framework-res identical to the factory, factory locales), CFI off for test builds as on the factory. Based on source-2.04: Source 2.04: PICO port pass 5 (Java and native PICO residue, libprocessgroup PICO groups, later-AOSP backports, Smartisan residue and CAF drift, installd and init scripts byte-identical to the factory; outputs/audit/rebase-log.md). init.rc is now the factory file: init_rc_edits keep only the trial ADB/diagnostics appends (the others duplicated factory-fs/mmi triggers and cgroup lines in 2.00-2.03), and factory_over_source drops the files Source now builds byte-identical. Based on source-2.03: Source 2.03: PICO port pass 4 (Smartisan layer: the factory sys-services.jar and sysmonitor-services.jar on the system server class path before services.jar as on the factory, with the services.jar Smartisan layer and hook sites they link against and call into; cgroup freezer, QuickBoot, meminfo, sensor freezing) - outputs/audit/rebase-log.md. source-2.02: Source 2.02: PICO port pass 3 (key policy, power, battery, shutdown animation, ApiLayer; WM/activities/IME/displays via IExt*; SurfaceFlinger/libgui; libEGL/libvulkan PICO layers, hwui RenderMonitor; audio Java/JNI, runtime; bootanimation; hidden-API flags) — outputs/audit/rebase-log.md. Based on source-2.01: Source 2.01: PICO port pass 1 on the CAF base (frameworks/base wm/input/IME/power/brightness, native, Wi-Fi, audio; outputs/audit/rebase-log.md), factory CPU variants kryo300/cortex-a75, factory framework-res overlay and PRODUCT_CHARACTERISTICS device,nosdcard, factory PermissionController/SettingsProvider/InProcessNetworkStack (outputs/audit/config.md PKG-01, SET-01..06). Based on source-2.00: Source 2.00: first release on the Qualcomm CAF base LA.UM.8.12.c3-64900-sm8250.0 (the base of the factory PICO OS 5.13.7) instead of AOSP android-10.0.0_r47. The PICO/Smartisan port patches were rebased (outputs/audit/rebase-plan.md, rebase-log.md): 42 r47 patches that backported CAF code are dropped, SurfaceFlinger/VDS/refresh-rate/phase-offset work sits on CAF's own code, the generated compatibility_matrix.4.xml equals the factory one. Built from source/caf-10 with ALLOW_MISSING_DEPENDENCIES for vendor-side QTI modules, without the closed Snapdragon LLVM, QTI Bluetooth stack and cryptfs_hw sources (factory binaries carried as before). source-1.04: Source 1.04: patch 0139 (SurfaceFlinger): PICO VR vsync phase offsets from the factory libsurfaceflinger PhaseOffsets::updateConfigExt/updatePhaseOffsetsExt. The late SF/app offsets come from persist.pvr.sf.fps_early_gl_{sf,app}_phase_offset_ns_{72,90}hz (factory defaults) by panel period (< 12.5 ms = 90 Hz), re-applied in handleMessageRefresh when the vsync period changes (hardware vsync resync + VSyncModulator offsets), properties re-read at bootFinished. On 1.03 SF used the AOSP offsets; the VR compositor renders into the scanned-out buffer and artifacts grew with head motion. The update-tex-image offset is stored as in the factory; its consumer is not identified yet. source-1.03: Source 1.03: patch 0138 (wm/policy): the factory isPvr2DEnabled exceptions that were not ported. isCallerAllowedToLaunchOnDisplay allows every caller on the 2D app displays SystemExt creates (private virtual displays owned by the system uid): on 1.02 the PICO store started vrusercenter OauthActivity/LoginActivity, SystemExt created a panel display for it, the launch check denied the app and the login fell back to display 0 behind the VR shell (endless loading). Also: no relaunch of activities on 2D app displays for display moves, LaunchParamsController keeps a task on its stack display and skips the modifiers, launch params of 2D displays are not persisted, completePauseLocked updates only the paused stack's display, window type 2998 is an application layer. source-1.02: Source 1.02: panel transparency, VR refresh rate and hidden-dialog focus, ported from the factory image. Patch 0135 (SurfaceFlinger): HWC virtual displays only for Wi-Fi Display as in the factory CAF SurfaceFlinger (vendor.display.vds_allow_hwc), because the QTI HWC wrote PICO panel displays as RGBX_8888 and dropped their alpha; setAllowedDisplayConfigs honours only requests carrying the PICO marker config 3 (pxrhmdservice), as the factory SurfaceFlinger does, so DisplayManager no longer returns the panel to 90 Hz under the 72 Hz VR runtime (72 fps content on 90 Hz judder). Patch 0137 (SurfaceFlinger HWC2): display configs ordered by HWC config id (std::map, as in the factory CAF SurfaceFlinger); with the r47 unordered_map the indices were swapped, so pxrhmdservice's 72 Hz request {1, 3} selected 90 Hz. Patch 0136 (services): minimal systransserver (factory sys-services.jar SysTransServer, ISysTransServer), which every VR app start waited 5 s for. The factory system/etc/vintf/compatibility_matrix.4.xml replaces the r47 one: the r47 matrix requires CONFIG_MEMCG/CONFIG_MEMCG_SWAP on 4.19, the PICO kernel has no memcg, so VINTF verification failed and system_server showed an 'internal problem' SYSTEM_ERROR dialog on display 0, invisible in VR, that held the display 0 focus and kept VR apps and the shell loading. source-1.01: Source 1.01 (first numbered release, installed with the Source updater): patch 0134 (services: minimal transferserver, the factory ITransferServer of sysmonitor-services.jar, published by system_server; getMuduleEventInfo returns an empty event list, so libsysperfeventmonitor in pvrtrackingservice no longer crashes on a missing/empty reply after setup, which made the home screen load endlessly; AMS does not start persistent apps on the PICO provisioning deny list, as the factory AMS does, which stops the com.pvr.tobservice restart loop). Release numbering starts here; source-trial-01k is release 1.00. source-trial-01k: source-trial-01j plus patch 0133 (IMMS: IME of a 2D app panel on the SystemExt IME display, IME target display reported to native_shell) and a trial-only XRShell switch to injectInputEvent (the factory libinputreader routes XRShell uinput touches by EV_MSC/MSC_SERIAL display id; not ported yet). On 01j the setup wizard panel was visible and, with injection, clickable, but the keyboard opened on display 0. source-trial-01j: patch 0132 (display: PICO VR display flags carried from the virtual display to DisplayDeviceInfo/DisplayInfo and SurfaceFlinger): on 01i SystemExt launched the setup wizard on its panel display, but the display was not a Vr2dDisplay, its task was never reported and SystemExt recycled the display in a loop. source-trial-01i: the PICO VR window manager layer, stage 2a (patch 0131, frameworks/base services wm: SystemExt with the native_shell protocol, ExtActivityStartControllerImpl start interception/pending launches/virtual display selection, ExtActivityDisplayImpl top task tracking, hooks in ActivityStarter, ActivityStack, ActivityDisplay, RootActivityContainer, ActivityRecord, RootWindowContainer and ATMS). On 01h the SystemExt app published native_shell but system_server never called it, so no setup wizard or 2D panel was launched. source-trial-01h: patch 0130 (frameworks/native libgui: SurfaceMonitor looks up transferserver/systransserver with checkService): on 01g every layer and Surface creation blocked ~10 s in getService() of these absent PICO report services (userdebug enables the factory monitor path), so VRShell hung in SurfaceControl.nativeCreate and hit activity timeouts. source-trial-01g: the PICO API layer, stage 1 (patch 0129, frameworks/base services: com.android.server.api ApiLayerService/MsgDispatcher/broadcast and settings proxies reconstructed from the factory services.jar, IWindowManager transaction 10003 returns IApiLayer, hooks for IME, power, screen, activity starting and the default display top task). On 01e the PICO SDK inside VRShell got no API layer (factory ExtWindowManagerServiceImpl code 10003 missing), so app sessions were never registered and no 2D panel appeared. source-trial-01f: ADB over Wi-Fi: adbd also listens on TCP 5555 at every boot (service.adb.tcp.port set in the trial boot action, before init.usb.rc starts adbd); authorization still requires the /adb_keys key. 01e was the first Source trial to complete boot (sys.boot_completed=1, VR compositor, head and controller tracking). source-trial-01e: patch 0128 (frameworks/base services: BatteryStatsService.getIBatteryStatsOptEx returns null when the Smartisan sys services JAR is absent): on 01d system_server started for the first time and died in PHASE_SYSTEM_SERVICES_READY with ClassCastException ISysSvsFactory$7 -> IBatteryStatsOptEx from LightsService.onBootPhase. source-trial-01d: patch 0127 (frameworks/av: Qualcomm 8kuhd/timelapse8kuhd camcorder qualities and lpcm audio encoder from CodeLinaro, factory values 3001/3002/12): on 01c zygote aborted while preloading libmedia_jni (MediaProfiles.cpp:343 CHECK(quality != -1)) on the factory /vendor/etc/media_profiles_vendor.xml, so system_server never started (black screen); the factory libmmparserextractor.so (does not load on Source, media.extractor aborted in a loop) is no longer carried. source-trial-01c: boot-time USB ADB and /cache diagnostics: on 01b the headset still showed only MTP about 15 s after reboot, i.e. init applied persist.sys.usb.config=mtp at the boot trigger before the 01b property rule ran (AdbService reads persist.sys.usb.config once when system_server starts). 01c sets persist.sys.usb.config=mtp,adb in an init.rc boot action, which is queued before the imported init.usb.rc boot action that copies it to sys.usb.config, sets Settings.Global.adb_enabled=1 after start, and writes logcat (all buffers incl. kernel) and state snapshots to the unencrypted /cache so a black-screen boot can be diagnosed from the offline recovery. source-trial-01b: the factory vendor/build.prop sets persist.vendor.usb.config=mtp and vendor init.qcom.usb.rc copies it to persist.sys.usb.config; after the userdata wipe no stored adb setting exists, so AdbService (reads persist.sys.usb.config at start) disabled ADB and 01a exposed only MTP. An init.rc rule rewrites persist.sys.usb.config=mtp to mtp,adb. source-trial-01a: /adb_keys: on the device the factory vendor/default.prop (ro.adb.secure=1) is loaded after system/etc/prop.default and overrides the trial ro.adb.secure=0, so adbd asked for key authorization after the userdata wipe and the VR shell showed no prompt. Everything else equals source-trial-01. Original decision: First Source trial-boot system image. The Source system image of aosp_pico4pro-userdebug (framework, services, runtime/ART and the other APEXes, SELinux platform policy, vold, native libraries, boot image of 21 JARs) is the base. On top of it the factory 5.13.7 system components that the Source build does not provide are carried over byte-exact (only the certificate of platform-role APKs is replaced), so that PICO VR services, shell, launcher, apps, configs and prebuilts exist. vendor, product, odm, boot/kernel stay unchanged factory/current. Every carried ELF/JAR/APK is checked against the Source libraries/class path (tools/check-source-image.py).

tools.assemble: tools/assemble-source-image.py (--source-tree as WSL root, --stage, --build, --readback as WSL root)

selection.rule: path level: a factory path the Source image does not contain is carried unless excluded below; a path present in both keeps the Source file unless listed in factory_over_source or generated; package level: a package name present in both keeps the Source APK unless listed in packages_factory_over_source; Source-only packages absent from the factory image are dropped (the factory package set is mirrored)

exclude_factory.system/apex/**: the Source APEXes (runtime/ART, conscrypt, media, resolv, tzdata) are used
exclude_factory.system/etc/selinux/**: the Source platform SELinux policy (factory parity, validation/sepolicy-parity.json) is used
exclude_factory.**/oat/**: factory odex/vdex/art were compiled against the factory boot image; the Source boot image differs, carried APKs are compiled on the device at first boot
exclude_factory.system/bin/install-recovery.sh: trial only: the system image must not rewrite the recovery partition (the offline recovery can stay installed between trial iterations)
exclude_factory.system/pre_resource/sdcard/pre_resource/: size: the Source components (debug runtime APEX, larger libraries) add ~80 MiB over the factory content and the factory image had only 53 MiB free in the fixed 5704732672-byte logical system; this 300 MiB 8K demo video (copied to /sdcard on first run) is the only file dropped for space
exclude_factory.system/bin/gtop: factory toybox gtop applet (GPU top, /proc/gpu_procs) has no source and is not ported yet; the carried symlink makes our toybox recurse and SIGSEGV every 10 s (sysmonitor). Restore once the applet is ported.
exclude_factory.system/priv-app/SystemUpdate2/**: replaced by the Source Update app (device/pico/PICOA8110/source-update): same package com.picovr.updatesystem and components, installs signed Source OTA packages; the factory app would offer PICO firmware over Source

factory_over_source.system/usr/keylayout/Generic.kl: PICO controller keys (LCONTROLLER_HOME, RCONTROLLER_HOME, CAMERA, GESTURE_CALIBRATION)
factory_over_source.system/etc/fonts.xml: factory font configuration referencing the carried PICOSans fonts

packages_factory_over_source.com.android.packageinstaller: factory PicoPackageInstaller (priv-app/PicoPackageInstaller) replaces the Source PackageInstaller as on 5.13.7
packages_factory_over_source.com.android.permissioncontroller: factory PICO PermissionController renders runtime permission prompts in VR (VrGrantPermissionsActivity, PicoGrantPermissionsViewHandlerImpl, SurfaceProxy); the AOSP one shows invisible 2D dialogs (outputs/audit/config.md PKG-01)
packages_factory_over_source.com.android.providers.settings: factory PICO SettingsProvider: initPicoSettings (force_resizable_activities=1, animation scales 0, safe_boot_disallowed), PICO defaults (screen_off_timeout -1, brightness 201, lockscreen disabled, immersive confirmed), stabd restore notification (outputs/audit/config.md SET-01..06)
packages_factory_over_source.com.android.networkstack.inprocess: factory PICO InProcessNetworkStack (PICO TCP/slardar reporting strings, outputs/audit/config.md section 4)

selection.drop_source_packages_reason: package absent from the factory 5.13.7 system/product/vendor/odm; not installed on the trial image so the package set equals the factory one

drop_source_files.system/apex/com.android.apex.cts.shim.ap: CTS shim APEX of updatable_apex.mk, absent from factory

signing.rule: every carried factory system APK signed with a PICO role certificate is re-signed with the Source key of the same role (v1+v2, Source apksigner); other certificates are kept
signing.shadow_reason: android.uid.system members on the unchanged product partition: framework-res (scanned first) fixes the shared user certificate to the Source platform key, a later PICO-signed member fails with INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_INCONSISTENT_CERTIFICATES. A re-signed copy on /system is scanned before /product; the product copy is then skipped as a duplicate package
signing.mac_permissions_reason: trial only: apps left with the PICO certificate on product/vendor (android.uid.phone group, QTI product apps, vendor TimeService) keep the seinfo they had on 5.13.7; the entries are copied from the factory plat_mac_permissions.xml

generated.system/build.prop: Source build.prop + factory-only properties + trial identity (below)
generated.system/etc/public.libraries.txt: Source list + factory PICO/QTI public libraries
generated.system/etc/vintf/manifest.xml: Source framework manifest + factory-only HALs served from system

system/bin/trial-snapshot.sh.reason: trial only: snapshots at 1, 3 and 7 minutes (props, processes, dmesg, SurfaceFlinger/window/activity/usb/adb) on /cache and Settings.Global.adb_enabled=1

adb_keys.reason: trial only: adbd (system/core/adb/daemon/auth.cpp) trusts /adb_keys besides /data/misc/adb/adb_keys; the public ADB key of the project PC lets adb work after a userdata wipe although the factory vendor/default.prop forces ro.adb.secure=1

reasons.ro.build.version.security_patch: kept at the factory 2021-04-05 like preview 01: equals the boot header SPL (2021-04) that the kept boot passes to Keymaster; the real Source base SPL is ro.pico.aosp.base_spl
reasons.persist.logd.logpersistd*: trial only: logcatd keeps up to 1024 x 1 MiB rotated logcat files in /data/misc/logd
reasons.persist.logd.size: trial only: 16 MiB logd ring buffers
reasons.persist.sys.disable_rescue: trial only: RescueParty must not send a crashing system_server to recovery with a wipe prompt
reasons.ro.adb.secure: trial only: adbd without key authorization (userdebug, ro.debuggable=1, persist.sys.usb.config=adb); overridden on the device by the factory vendor/default.prop ro.adb.secure=1, see extra_files adb_keys
reasons.ro.logd.kernel: factory prop.default value: logd collects the kernel log
reasons.ro.source.version: Source release number (1.01, 1.02, ...); tools/source-ota.py reads it to pick the update base

insert: # Source test builds: USB and TCP ADB at boot (the factory vendor forces persist.sys.usb.config=mtp).
# source-trial-01b (trial only): the factory vendor copies persist.vendor.usb.config=mtp

init_rc_not_applied.note: Source 2.04 builds the factory init.rc byte-identically (system/core 9c66c39); only the trial ADB/diagnostics appends are applied.

ld_config_edits.reason: factory: audioserver loads the spatializer effect (carried /system/lib64/soundfx/libspatializer.so)
factory (PICO VCMotor): vendor processes load the carried system libstationclient.pxr.so
